title: DARSY: A Tool for Data-Driven Abstraction and Policy Synthesis for Stochastic Systems with Unknown Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.25654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents DARSY: a software tool for abstraction-based verification and policy synthesis in discrete-time stochastic control systems with unknown dynamics and noise distributions. DARSY requires only a simulator of the system and a Lipschitz bound on its dynamics, and needs no knowledge of dynamics or noise distributions. The tool is fully automated and constructs a finite interval Markov decision process (IMDP) abstraction from sampled transitions, whose probability intervals are obtained via statistical techniques and Lipschitz reasoning. Robust dynamic programming on this IMDP then yields a policy together with a lower bound on the probability that the unknown system satisfies a desired specification. This lower bound holds with a user-specified confidence; that is, it is probably approximately correct (PAC). The tool is implemented in Python and supports general Lipschitz-continuous system dynamics and specifications expr

translated_title: DARSY：一种面向未知动力学随机系统的数据驱动抽象与策略合成工具
translated_abstract: 本文提出了DARSY：一个软件工具，用于对具有未知动力学和噪声分布的离散时间随机控制系统进行基于抽象的验证与策略合成。DARSY只需要系统的模拟器和其动力学的Lipschitz界，无需任何关于动力学或噪声分布的先验知识。该工具完全自动化，从采样的状态转移中构建有限区间马尔可夫决策过程（IMDP）抽象，其概率区间通过统计技术和Lipschitz推理获得。随后在该IMDP上执行鲁棒动态规划，得到一个策略以及未知系统满足期望规约的概率下界。该下界在用户指定的置信度下成立，即具有概率近似正确（PAC）保证。该工具采用Python实现，支持一般的Lipschitz连续系统动力学和规约。
tldr: DARSY是一个只需系统模拟器和Lipschitz界的全自动工具，它通过从采样数据构建区间马尔可夫决策过程抽象并结合鲁棒动态规划，为未知动力学的随机控制系统提供具有PAC保证的策略合成与验证。
en_tdlr: DARSY is a fully automated tool that, requiring only a system simulator and a Lipschitz bound, synthesizes policies with PAC guarantees for stochastic control systems with unknown dynamics by constructing interval MDP abstractions from sampled data and applying robust dynamic programming.
